correctness.rationale: The shell-localization argument gives arbitrary bounded sequence interpolation modulo \(c_0\), while the localized Jacobi-moment construction produces uniformly controlled radial symbols realizing the coordinate tails needed to recover \(c_0\). Combining the two inclusions gives norm density in \(\ell_\infty\); the multiplicity-free homogeneous decomposition then identifies the radial commutant with the diagonal sequence algebra and its compact ideal with \(c_0\). An earlier published theorem is stronger still: it proves exact surjectivity of the bounded radial-symbol eigenvalue map onto \(\ell_\infty\), so the present norm-saturation conclusions follow a fortiori.
residual_risks: Full text of the very recent Bdarneh preprint was unavailable through direct/open routes and institutional retrieval was unavailable; this does not affect correctness because the stronger prior published record supplies the conclusion independently.
